Same mixed occupation/in-lieu line as receipts[3]. p5 treats it as in-lieu of tax ('other local taxes'). No review flag.

Split is not printed on the page. It is inferred: the p7 total of 610,079 is the p4 General Fund Miscellaneous 379,994 plus the 230,085 transfer in, and every other p7 Total line equals p4. issues.on_page: Street - Capital outlay 374,896; Parks - Capital outlay 508,287 (p8, detail[74])
issues.issue: On p4 these two capital outlay lines (together 883,183) are the 'Capital outlays' disbursement line, categorized as capital outlay. In detail they are categorized under department functions (streets/highways, culture/recreation), so the same money has different categories in the two lists. Applies to detail[40] and detail[74].
